items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: And he worked for Frank Doatree even then.

ctx.x: Well, I thought he almost stayed there and lived there or something like that. No, he'd go there. No, uh-uh.
And he worked for Frank Doatree even then. And then he was a watchman at night at this place when he was building up the new store. And then after… What store was that? Frank Doatree.
